description: Hand-curated AUTHORITATIVE toll rates for Rajasthan State Highways Authority (RSHA) plazas, sourced from RSHA's own newspaper-publication rate notification for FY 2026-27 (letter no. 1079 dated 30.03.2026, PIU Kota, forwarded to DIPR Rajasthan for publication). merge.js applies these as overrides on top of the scaffolded/NETC base rates. Only fields explicitly listed under `rates` are overridden; everything else is left untouched. Vehicle-class mapping: the notification's 'Car,jeep,LMV' column maps to car_*; 'LCV,LGV,Mini Bus' maps to lcv_*; 'Bus or Truck' (a single combined column in the source) maps to bus_*; 'HCM,EME,MAV' (3-6 axle, per Rajasthan State Highways Fee Rules 2015 Rule 4(2)) maps to BOTH hcm_* and axle_4_6_* (mirrored, matching the existing convention already used for NHAI plazas in this dataset where these two fields are identical); 'Oversized vehicles' (7+ axle) maps to axle_7_plus_*. The '_monthly' field is populated from the notification's 'Discounted rate for 50 or more one-way toll tickets during a period of one month' column (a bulk-ticket monthly scheme), NOT the separate flat Rs.310/month non-commercial resident pass (Rule 9(3) of the 2015 Rules), which is vehicle-class-agnostic and has no home in this per-class schema. Full source text independently re-verified via direct pdfminer text extraction on 2026-07-07 (an earlier WebFetch-based check incorrectly reported this URL as an unrelated ad-booking notice — that check used a summarization model that failed to parse this PDF's mixed Hindi/English table content; the pdfminer extraction confirms the real letter number, date, and complete rate table verbatim).
